    "def application(file):\n",
    "    minadder, minmulti = 1,1                                                         #r1min r2min  \n",
    "    maxadder, maxmulti = 0,0                                                         #initialized with 0\n",
    "    arAdder,arMulti, arRegister, delayAdder, delayMulti = 0,0,0,0,0                  #initialized with 0\n",
    "    for i in file:\n",
    "        if len(i)!=0:\n",
    "            if i[0] == 'adder(16)' and maxadder<int(i[-1]):\n",
    "                maxadder = int(i[-1])\n",
    "                arAdder = eval(i[2][:-2])\n",
    "                delayAdder = eval(i[3][:-2])\n",
    "            elif i[0] == 'multiplier(16)' and maxmulti<int(i[-1]):\n",
    "                maxmulti = int(i[-1])\n",
    "                arMulti = eval(i[2][:-2])\n",
    "                delayMulti = eval(i[3][:-2])\n",
    "            elif i[0].find(\"register\") != -1:\n",
    "                arRegister = eval(i[0].split()[1][:-2])\n",
    "    #print(arAdder,arMulti, arRegister, delayAdder, delayMulti)\n",
    "    return (minadder, minmulti, maxadder, maxmulti, arAdder,arMulti, arRegister, delayAdder, delayMulti)"
   ]
  },

    "class Node:\n",
    "    def __init__(self, s):\n",
    "        self.operator = s[0]\n",
    "        self.operand_1 = int(s[1])\n",
    "        self.operand_2 = int(s[2])\n",
    "        self.id = int(s[3])\n",
    "        self.control_step = None"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "def read_file(s):\n",
    "    file = open(s)\n",
    "    fir = file.read()\n",
    "    file.close()\n",
    "    fir_dfg = \"\"\n",
    "    for i in fir:\n",
    "        if i != '\\n':\n",
    "            fir_dfg += i\n",
    "    fir_dfg = fir_dfg.split(\",\")\n",
    "    return fir_dfg"
   ]
  },

    "def resource_constraint(sign, resources):\n",
    "    list_of_nodes = []\n",
    "    for i in range(int(len(sign)/4)):\n",
    "        list_of_nodes.append(Node(sign[i*4:i*4+4]))\n",
    "    operators = {}\n",
    "    for i in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        operators[i.operator] = None\n",
    "    for i in operators:\n",
    "        if i == '+':\n",
    "            operators[i] = resources[0]\n",
    "        if i == '*':\n",
    "            operators[i] = resources[1]\n",
    "    return operators, list_of_nodes"
   ]
  },

    "def scheduling(operators, list_of_nodes):\n",
    "    c_oper = {}\n",
    "    t_op = {}\n",
    "    count = len(list_of_nodes)\n",
    "    #print(\"count\",count)\n",
    "    for i in range(count):\n",
    "        t_oper = {}\n",
    "        for j in operators:\n",
    "            t_oper[j] = operators[j]\n",
    "        t_op[i] = t_oper\n",
    "    for i in operators:\n",
    "        c_oper[i] = 1\n",
    "    #print(c_oper)\n",
    "    t_oper = {}\n",
    "    for i in operators:\n",
    "        t_oper[i] = operators[i]\n",
    "    #print(t_oper)\n",
    "    for node in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        if node.operand_1 == 0 and node.operand_2 == 0:\n",
    "            if t_oper[node.operator] == 0:\n",
    "                c_oper[node.operator] += 1\n",
    "                t_oper[node.operator] = operators[node.operator]\n",
    "            node.control_step = c_oper[node.operator]\n",
    "            t_oper[node.operator] -= 1\n",
    "            t_op[node.control_step-1][node.operator] -= 1\n",
    "            count -= 1\n",
    "            #print(node.operator,\" \",node.id,\" \",node.control_step)\n",
    "    #print(t_oper)\n",
    "    #print(c_oper)\n",
    "    #print(t_op)\n",
    "    #print(count)\n",
    "    while count != 0:\n",
    "        for node in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "            if node.control_step == None:\n",
    "                if node.operand_1 == 0 and node.operand_2 != 0:\n",
    "                    if list_of_nodes[node.operand_2 - 1].control_step != None:\n",
    "                        max_c = max(0, list_of_nodes[node.operand_2 - 1].control_step)\n",
    "                        #if t_oper[node.operator] == 0:\n",
    "                        #    c_oper[node.operator] += 1\n",
    "                        #    t_oper[node.operator] = operators[node.operator]\n",
    "                        while((t_op[max_c][node.operator]) == 0) :\n",
    "                            max_c += 1\n",
    "                        if (((1 + max_c) > c_oper[node.operator]) or (t_op[max_c][node.operator]) != 0):\n",
    "                                c_oper[node.operator] = 1 + max_c\n",
    "                                t_oper[node.operator] = t_op[max_c][node.operator]\n",
    "                                node.control_step = c_oper[node.operator]\n",
    "                        node.control_step = c_oper[node.operator]\n",
    "                        t_oper[node.operator] -= 1\n",
    "                        t_op[node.control_step-1][node.operator] -= 1\n",
    "                        count -= 1\n",
    "                        #print(node.operator,\" \",node.id,\" \",node.control_step)\n",
    "                elif node.operand_1 != 0 and node.operand_2 == 0:\n",
    "                    if list_of_nodes[node.operand_1 - 1].control_step != None:\n",
    "                        max_c = max(0, list_of_nodes[node.operand_1 - 1].control_step)\n",
    "                        #if t_oper[node.operator] == 0:\n",
    "                        #    c_oper[node.operator] += 1\n",
    "                        #    t_oper[node.operator] = operators[node.operator]\n",
    "                        while((t_op[max_c][node.operator]) == 0) :\n",
    "                            max_c += 1\n",
    "                        if (((1 + max_c) > c_oper[node.operator]) or (t_op[max_c][node.operator]) != 0):\n",
    "                                c_oper[node.operator] = 1 + max_c\n",
    "                                t_oper[node.operator] = t_op[max_c][node.operator]\n",
    "                                node.control_step = c_oper[node.operator]\n",
    "                        node.control_step = c_oper[node.operator]\n",
    "                        t_oper[node.operator] -= 1\n",
    "                        t_op[node.control_step-1][node.operator] -= 1\n",
    "                        count -= 1\n",
    "                        #print(node.operator,\" \",node.id,\" \",node.control_step)\n",
    "                else:\n",
    "                    if list_of_nodes[node.operand_1 - 1].control_step != None and list_of_nodes[node.operand_2 - 1].control_step != None:\n",
    "                        max_c = max(list_of_nodes[node.operand_1 - 1].control_step, list_of_nodes[node.operand_2 - 1].control_step)\n",
    "                        #if t_oper[node.operator] == 0:\n",

    "def register_allocation(list_of_nodes, max_con):\n",
    "    graph_node = {}\n",
    "    registers = {}\n",
    "    node_c = {}\n",
    "    counter = 0\n",
    "    node_c[0] = 0\n",
    "    for node in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        node_c[node.id] = node.control_step\n",
    "    for i in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        if i.operand_1 == 0 and i.operand_2 == 0:\n",
    "            graph_node[counter] = []\n",
    "            registers[counter] = []\n",
    "            graph_node[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            counter += 1\n",
    "    for i in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        if i.operand_1 == 0 and i.operand_2 == 0:\n",
    "            graph_node[counter] = []\n",
    "            registers[counter] = []\n",
    "            graph_node[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            counter += 1\n",
    "    for i in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        if i.operand_1 == 0 and i.operand_2 != 0 or i.operand_1 != 0 and i.operand_2 == 0:\n",
    "            graph_node[counter] = []\n",
    "            registers[counter] = []\n",
    "            graph_node[counter].append(0)\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(i.operand_1)\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(i.operand_2)\n",
    "            counter += 1\n",
    "            \n",
    "    temp = counter - 1\n",
    "    for i in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "        graph_node[counter] = []\n",
    "        registers[counter] = []\n",
    "        graph_node[counter].append(i.control_step)\n",
    "        if i.operand_1 != 0:\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(i.operand_1+temp)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(i.id-1)\n",
    "        if i.operand_2 != 0:\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(i.operand_2+temp)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            registers[counter].append(i.id-1)\n",
    "        for j in range(node_c[i.operand_1], i.control_step):\n",
    "            if i.operand_1 != 0:    \n",
    "                graph_node[i.operand_1+temp].append(j)\n",
    "                graph_node[i.operand_1+temp] = list(set(graph_node[i.operand_1+temp]))\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                graph_node[i.id-1].append(j)\n",
    "                graph_node[i.id-1] = list(set(graph_node[i.id-1]))\n",
    "        for j in range(node_c[i.operand_2], i.control_step):\n",
    "            if i.operand_2 != 0:    \n",
    "                graph_node[i.operand_2+temp].append(j)\n",
    "                graph_node[i.operand_2+temp] = list(set(graph_node[i.operand_2+temp]))\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                graph_node[i.id-1].append(j)\n",
    "                graph_node[i.id-1] = list(set(graph_node[i.id-1]))\n",
    "        counter += 1\n",
    "    graph_node\n",
    "    graph_node_c = {}\n",
    "    for i in range(max_con+1):\n",
    "        graph_node_c[i] = []\n",
    "        for j in graph_node:\n",
    "            if i in graph_node[j]:\n",
    "                graph_node_c[i].append(j)\n",
    "                \n",
    "    graph_nodes = {}\n",
    "    for i in range(len(graph_node)):\n",
    "        graph_nodes[i] = []\n",
    "        for j in range(len(graph_node)):\n",
    "            if i!=j:\n",
    "                if len(set(graph_node[j]).intersection(set(graph_node[i])))>0:\n",
    "                    graph_nodes[i].append(j)\n",
    "    edges = []\n",
    "    for i in graph_nodes:\n",
    "        for j in graph_nodes[i]:\n",
    "            edges.append((i,j))\n",
    "   \n",
    "    return edges, graph_node_c, graph_nodes, temp, registers"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 530,
   "id": "9fee1656",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def register_coloring(graph_nodes):\n",
    "    res = [-1 for x in range(len(graph_nodes))]\n",
    "    available = [False for x in range(len(graph_nodes))]\n",
    "    cn = 0\n",
    "    for each_node in graph_nodes:\n",
    "        for adj_node in graph_nodes[each_node]:\n",
    "            if res[adj_node] != -1:\n",
    "                available[res[adj_node]] = True\n",
    "    \n",
    "        cr = 0\n",
    "        for no in range(len(available)):\n",
    "            if available[no] == False:\n",
    "                cr = no\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        res[each_node] = cr\n",
    "        cn = max(cn,cr+1)\n",
    "    \n",
    "        for adj_node in graph_nodes[each_node]:\n",
    "            if res[adj_node] != -1:\n",
    "                available[res[adj_node]] = False\n",
    "    return cn, res"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 531,
   "id": "14c8a1c4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def register_recoloring(cn, register_c, graph_nodes, graph_node_c, temp, registers):\n",
    "    register_c = [-1 for i in range(len(graph_nodes))]\n",
    "    for cycle in graph_node_c:\n",
    "        cc = 0\n",
    "        cl = []\n",
    "        if cycle == 0:\n",
    "            for i in range(temp+1):\n",
    "                register_c[i] = cc\n",
    "                cc += 1\n",
    "            continue\n",
    "        for reg in graph_node_c[cycle]:\n",
    "            if register_c[reg] == -1:\n",
    "                if register_c[min(registers[reg])] not in cl:\n",
    "                    register_c[reg] = register_c[min([register_c[each] for each in registers[reg] ])]\n",
    "                    cl.append(register_c[min([register_c[each] for each in registers[reg] ])])\n",
    "                else:\n",
    "                    k = register_c[min(registers[reg])]\n",
    "                    while k not in cl:\n",
    "                        k += 1\n",
    "                        if k == cn:\n",
    "                            k /= cn\n",
    "                    register_c[reg] = k\n",
    "                    cl.append(k)\n",
    "   \n",
    "    return register_c"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 532,
   "id": "c6a89fbc",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def find_max1_max_0(register_c):\n",
    "    n_e = int(len(register_c)/2) + 1\n",
    "    n_o = len(register_c) - n_e \n",
    "    max_0 = int((n_e*(n_e-1))/2)\n",
    "    max_1 = int((n_o*(n_o-1))/2)\n",
    "   \n",
    "    return max_0, max_1"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 533,
   "id": "60ae7e85",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def no_of_digits(max_0, max_1, digital_template):\n",
    "    total_count = max_0 + max_1\n",
    "    point_count = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(total_count):\n",
    "        if i <len(digital_template) and digital_template[i] == '.':\n",
    "            point_count += 1\n",
    "    total_count += point_count\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return total_count, point_count"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 534,
   "id": "6b881b5f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def final_count(total_count, digital_template):\n",
    "    no_of_zeros = 0\n",
    "    no_of_ones = 0\n",
    "    no_of_pr = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(total_count):\n",
    "        if i< len(digital_template) and digital_template[i] == '1':\n",
    "            no_of_ones += 1\n",
    "        elif i < len(digital_template) and digital_template[i] == '0':\n",
    "            no_of_zeros += 1\n",
    "        elif i < len(digital_template) and digital_template[i] == 'P':\n",
    "            no_of_pr += 1\n",
    "    #print(no_of_ones, no_of_zeros, point_count)\n",
    "    ones = min(no_of_ones, max_1)\n",
    "    zeros = min(no_of_zeros, max_0)\n",
    "    pr1 =  no_of_pr\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return ones, zeros, pr1"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "def adding_edges(register_c, ones, zeros, pr, graph_nodes, point_count):\n",
    "    constraints = []\n",
    "    q_count = 0\n",
    "    p =[]\n",
    "    used = []\n",
    "    for num in range(2, len(register_c)):\n",
    "        # all prime numbers are greater than 1\n",
    "        if num > 1:\n",
    "            for i in range(2, num):\n",
    "                if (num % i) == 0:\n",
    "                    break\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                p.append(num)\n",
    "    #print(p)\n",
    "    for i in range(0,len(p)):\n",
    "        if q_count == pr:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        for j in range(i+1,len(p)):\n",
    "            if p[i]!=p[j]:\n",
    "                graph_nodes[p[i]].append(p[j])\n",
    "                graph_nodes[p[j]].append(p[i])\n",
    "                graph_nodes[p[j]] = list(set(graph_nodes[p[j]]))\n",
    "                constraints.append((p[i],p[j]))\n",
    "                q_count += 1\n",
    "                used.append((0,p[j]))\n",
    "            if q_count == pr:\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        graph_nodes[p[i]] = list(set(graph_nodes[p[i]]))\n",
    "    z_count = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(0,len(register_c),2):\n",
    "        if z_count == zeros:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        for j in range(i,len(register_c),2):\n",
    "            if i!=j:\n",
    "                graph_nodes[i].append(j)\n",
    "                graph_nodes[j].append(i)\n",
    "                graph_nodes[j] = list(set(graph_nodes[j]))\n",
    "                z_count += 1\n",
    "                constraints.append((i,j))\n",
    "            if z_count == zeros:\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        graph_nodes[i] = list(set(graph_nodes[i]))\n",
    "    o_count = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(1,len(register_c),2):\n",
    "        if o_count == ones:\n",
    "            break\n",
    "        for j in range(i,len(register_c),2):\n",
    "            if i!=j:\n",
    "                graph_nodes[i].append(j)\n",
    "                graph_nodes[j].append(i)\n",
    "                graph_nodes[j] = list(set(graph_nodes[j]))\n",
    "                constraints.append((i,j))\n",
    "                o_count += 1\n",
    "            if o_count == ones:\n",
    "                break\n",
    "        graph_nodes[i] = list(set(graph_nodes[i]))\n",
    "    for i in range(1,len(register_c),2):\n",
    "        #graph_nodes[0].append(i)\n",
    "        #graph_nodes[i].append(0)\n",
    "        #graph_nodes[0] = list(set(graph_nodes[0]))\n",
    "        #graph_nodes[i] = list(set(graph_nodes[i]))\n",
    "        #constraints.append((0,i))\n",
    "        #p_count += 1\n",
    "        edges = []\n",
    "        for i in graph_nodes:\n",
    "            for j in graph_nodes[i]:\n",
    "                edges.append((i,j))\n",
    "    return edges, constraints, graph_nodes"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "source": [
    "def constraints(file, file_,  list_of_nodes, maxcon, operators, test= None):\n",
    "    minadder, minmulti, maxadder, maxmulti, arAdder,arMulti, arRegister, delayAdder, delayMulti = application(file)\n",
    "  \n",
    "    mx = {}\n",
    "    time = 0\n",
    "    area = 0\n",
    "    if test == 1:\n",
    "            s_i = read_file(file_)\n",
    "            operators, list_of_nodes = resource_constraint(s_i, [maxadder, maxmulti])\n",
    "            print(maxadder, maxmulti)\n",
    "            \n",
    "            list_of_nodes, maxcon = scheduling(operators, list_of_nodes)\n",
    "    if test == 0:\n",
    "            s_i = read_file(file_)\n",
    "            operators, list_of_nodes = resource_constraint(s_i, [minadder, minmulti])\n",
    "            \n",
    "            list_of_nodes, maxcon = scheduling(operators, list_of_nodes)\n",
    "    test = None\n",
    "    for k in operators:\n",
    "        mx[k] = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(1,maxcon+1):\n",
    "        resources = {}\n",
    "        for k in operators:\n",
    "            resources[k] = 0\n",
    "        for node in list_of_nodes:\n",
    "            if node.control_step == i:\n",
    "                resources[node.operator] += 1\n",
    "        for k in resources:\n",
    "            if mx[k] < resources[k]:\n",
    "                mx[k] = resources[k]\n",
    "        a = 0\n",
    "        b = 0\n",
    "        for k in resources:\n",
    "            if k == '+' and resources[k] != 0:\n",
    "                a = delayAdder\n",
    "            if k == '*' and resources[k] != 0:\n",
    "                b = delayMulti\n",
    "        if a>b:\n",
    "            time += a\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            time += b\n",
    "                \n",
    "    for k in mx:\n",
    "        if k == '+':\n",
    "            mx[k] = mx[k]*arAdder\n",
    "        elif k == '*':\n",
    "            mx[k] = mx[k]*arMulti\n",
    "    for k in mx:\n",
    "        area += mx[k]\n",
    "    return area, time"
   ]
  },

    "    mydata = []\n",
    "    for i in graph_node_c:\n",
    "        temp = []\n",
    "        for j in range(int(cn)):\n",
    "            test = 0\n",
    "            for k in graph_node_c[i]:\n",
    "                if register_c[k] == j:\n",
    "                    temp.append(k)\n",
    "                    test = 1\n",
    "            if test == 0:\n",
    "                temp.append('-')\n",
    "        mydata.append(temp)\n",
    "   \n",
    "    return mydata, head"
   ]

    "#PSO\n",
    "def AETP(position, swarm_size, dim, L, U):\n",
    "    for i in range(swarm_size):\n",
    "        for j in range(dim):\n",
    "            while(position[i][j] < L[j]):\n",
    "                position[i][j] = L[j]\n",
    "            while (position[i][j] > U[j]):\n",
    "                position[i][j] = U[j]\n",
    "    return position"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 539,
   "id": "4a5f7800",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#PSO\n",
    "def PVC(velocity, swarm_size, dim, n_vmax, p_vmax):\n",
    "    for i in range(swarm_size):\n",
    "        for j in range(dim):\n",
    "            if n_vmax > velocity[i][j]:\n",
    "                velocity[i][j] = n_vmax\n",
    "            if p_vmax < velocity[i][j]:\n",
    "                velocity[i][j] = p_vmax\n",
    "    return velocity"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "ba9af829",

   "source": [
    "#PSO\n",
    "def ARM(position, swarm_size, dim):\n",
    "    for i in range(swarm_size):\n",
    "        if (i%2==1): # Left Rotation \n",
    "            for j in range(dim-1):\n",
    "                Temp = position[i][j] \n",
    "                position[i][j]= position[i][j+1]      #j+1 i.e. dimension-1\n",
    "                position[i][j+1]= Temp\n",
    "                \n",
    "        if(i%2==0):\n",
    "            X = random.randint(-3,3)\n",
    "            for j in range(dim):\n",
    "                position[i][j] = position[i][j] + X #X is a random number between [1,3]   \n",
    "\n",
    "    return position"
   ]
  },
